messages:
Maya K: Hey finance — my corporate card shows a charge from yesterday: 'VisaExpress INC 220.00 USD' for an expedited visa for the London customer workshop. I bought it on my personal card because the corpcard was declined at checkout; finance already charged the corpcard and I see a duplicate. Can we reconcile or reimburse the personal charge? I attached the PDF receipt to the expense entry.

Finance Bot: Automated: Please attach the receipt and include manager approval for any visa/immigration fees. Policy excerpt: "visa expedite fees are reimbursable only when travel is customer-critical and pre-approved by manager." Link: https://intra.redwood/expenses#visas :information_source:

Maya K: Attached receipt in Concur. Quick copy of receipt text: 
```
VisaExpress Ltd.
Service: Visa Expedited Processing
Amount: USD 220.00
Date: 2026-02-14
Reference: VX-998732
```
Account for reimbursement: Chase (ending 4321). I also pinged Jon for approval.

Jon Park: Approved — this was last-minute to secure the meeting with Acme. Please reimburse Maya. 

Finance Bot: Please submit the Concur claim with category `Travel - Visa`, add a screenshot of Jon's approval or forward this thread. Reimbursement method: ACH (to last 4 4321). Processing ETA: 2 payroll cycles.

Elena R: Logged this as an exception (EX-2026-014). I'll reconcile the corpcard duplicate charge and mark the personal txn for reimbursement once Concur is complete. Need project code — Maya, what project should this be charged to?

Maya K: Charge to project `ENG-SRE-301` (client: Acme). Also note corpcard transaction ID on the card statement: CC-TXN-5509 — looks like the vendor rebilled me after the decline.

People Ops: Heads up — we'll update the policy wording to include an explicit clause for last-minute visa fees for customer-critical travel; please include the manager approval in the exception log. :memo:

Jon Park: Confirming project `ENG-SRE-301` and that this is customer-critical. :thumbsup:

Finance Bot: Reimbursement queued (queue id: RQ-7743). Corpcard duplicate flagged for chargeback investigation (ticket CB-88). Will update when ACH is sent.

Elena R: Got everything; processing now. Will update when ACH posts. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
